soundAtlas.profile.none: Shown after placing a listening point

soundAtlas.reason.roadworkNotCovered: Not covered: this city does not publish roadwork events
soundAtlas.reason.workHours: Within permit period, daily hours unknown
soundAtlas.row.roadProxyNote: Estimate, not volume: road class only (New Taipei); constant over time
soundAtlas.reason.typicalWeekend: Weekend or public holiday: no reliable typical value
soundAtlas.reason.typicalAnomaly: Anomalous day (e.g. typhoon): no same-day observation, typical value not applicable
soundAtlas.reason.typicalCalendar: Holiday calendar does not cover this date; cannot tell if it is a weekday
soundAtlas.reason.typicalMissing: No valid typical volume for this hour
soundAtlas.reason.typicalSample: Too few sample days for this hour
soundAtlas.row.typicalNote: Estimate: Dec 2025–Jan 2026 weekday typical value ({days}-day sample), not a same-day observation
soundAtlas.provider.waveObs: CWA hourly buoy / tide-station waves (S3 archive)
soundAtlas.precision.windCanopy: Nearest weather station wind × canopy around the point
soundAtlas.precision.waveCoast: Offshore buoy × distance to nearshore zone (not the current shoreline)
soundAtlas.precision.riverChannel: Nearest water-level station × distance to channel
soundAtlas.reason.noVegetation: No canopy data loaded here (the snapshot only covers the original point's surroundings)
soundAtlas.reason.canopyAmbiguous: Canopy data cannot tell open ground, sea or missing data apart
soundAtlas.reason.naturalNotLoaded: No coast or river-channel data loaded here
soundAtlas.reason.outsideStations: Outside the station area of the scene snapshot
soundAtlas.reason.noQuantiles: This station has no 60-day history to compare with

soundAtlas.route.title: Main sound sources along the route
soundAtlas.route.drawing: Click the map to add points ({n} so far, Esc to cancel)
soundAtlas.route.noneActive: no active sources along the way
soundAtlas.route.chartLabel: Relative source activity along the route (not dB)
soundAtlas.route.notExposure: Source activity met along the route, not noise exposure; constant speed, no stops. Right-hand % = share of the route where the source is active.
soundAtlas.route.limits: Limits: departure = timeline time when you press Done; garbage trucks only for cities near the listening point; scene snapshots cover the scene area only; same-day data only, segments after midnight cannot be judged.
soundAtlas.route.hint: Press Draw route, click two or more points on the map, then Done; departure uses the current timeline time.
soundAtlas.rainCell.title: Rain grid (estimated)
soundAtlas.rainCell.source.gauge: Rain gauge (higher than radar; hourly data)
soundAtlas.rainCell.source.gaugeOnly: Rain gauge (hourly data; no radar data for this day)
soundAtlas.rainCell.radarNone: No radar data for this day
soundAtlas.rainCell.note: Estimated from radar echo and rain gauges, taking the higher of the two; the Z-R conversion and class thresholds are assumptions. Gauges report hourly, so every 10-minute slot in that hour reuses the same reading. The gauge time is the observation time; the value is the 60-minute total before it, so it can be later than the grid slot (the slot usually lies inside the accumulation window).
soundAtlas.reason.radarFrame: Radar image missing or suspected clutter for this slot, and no rain gauge within 5 km
soundAtlas.provider.radar: CWA composite radar image (classes decoded from its color scale)
soundAtlas.road.evidence.estimated: Taipei streets · typical January weekday VD (extension along the road is assumed)
soundAtlas.road.evidence.inferred: New Taipei streets · estimated from road class
soundAtlas.roadCell.title: Road traffic grid
soundAtlas.roadCell.flowNote.observed: One 1-minute count fetched in this 10-minute slot ×60; noisier than an average
soundAtlas.roadCell.flowNote.estimated: Typical weekday value for this hour (Dec 2025–Jan 2026), not a same-day observation
soundAtlas.roadCell.flowNote.inferred: Fixed estimate by road class; does not change with time (03:00 equals 08:00)
soundAtlas.roadCell.otherUnknown: Other roads nearby cannot be assessed (incl. minor streets); it may be louder
soundAtlas.roadCell.note: Potential = distance term × volume term; the highest road in a cell wins; not dB. The grid and the receiver panel share one rule.
soundAtlas.reason.freewayPackMissing: No freeway VD data for this day
soundAtlas.reason.freewayNoVd: No VD within 2 km on this freeway section
soundAtlas.reason.freewayVdFault: Freeway VD faulty or missing that day
soundAtlas.reason.freewaySample: Freeway VD not fetched in this 10 minutes
soundAtlas.reason.taipeiNoVd: Taipei road not reached by any VD extension
soundAtlas.precision.freewayVd: Freeway section matched to VD by mileage
soundAtlas.row.freewayObservedNote: Same-day observation: freeway VD 1-minute volume ×60 (one per 10 minutes)
soundAtlas.reason.noFullAreaSource: No full-area source file for this day; the grid cannot be judged (the receiver panel still works nearby)
soundAtlas.reason.noPackForDate: No precomputed aircraft grid for this day
soundAtlas.reason.packSourceMismatch: The grid pack does not match the loaded flight trails, so it is not used
soundAtlas.reason.outsidePackTime: Outside the time range of the grid pack
soundAtlas.reason.receiverOutsideGrid: The receiver is outside the Taipei–New Taipei grid, so the grid is hidden
soundAtlas.potentialCell.title: {family} grid
soundAtlas.potentialCell.note: Cell value = the highest relative potential at the cell centre within these 10 minutes, using the same rules as the receiver panel; not dB.
soundAtlas.potentialCell.aviationNote: The aircraft grid comes from a precomputed pack (stored at level boundaries); the exact value above is recomputed live at the cell centre.
soundAtlas.potentialCell.railNote: Positions are inferred from timetables and do not reflect same-day suspensions or delays; underground sections are excluded.
soundAtlas.tool.closed: Point query is off (layers are still on).
soundAtlas.cell.title: Grid values at this cell (250 m, this 10 minutes)
soundAtlas.cell.outside: Outside the grid (Taipei + New Taipei only); the sources above are still listed.
soundAtlas.cell.notLoaded: This source is off or not loaded yet
soundAtlas.composite.title: Combined soundscape
soundAtlas.composite.note: Variant B weights are assumptions, not calibrated.
soundAtlas.composite.noSourceShort: Not enough data for this day — mostly hatched
soundAtlas.reason.noneLow: none of the {known} sources with data reach "low"
soundAtlas.reason.knownQuiet: all {known} sources with data are low
